findings.issue: The second resumeOnCallback runs after the first already drove the run to completed, so the no-op is via 'status no longer waiting_for_reply' rather than a truly simultaneous two-thread tap race.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable: this is the realistic double-click scenario (sequential taps). The atomic CAS that also covers the simultaneous race is already proven by the Phase-1 atomicClaimRaceAcrossTwoReplicas IT on the same findAndModify primitive. No change.

notes: All 13 integration anchors + 3 unit anchors from the task TDD section are present with exact names.
